ugly.translation: a. 丑陋的, 邪恶的, 险恶的, 不祥的\nn. 丑陋的人(或物)

examples.en: Compared to the others, doesn't the French passport look ugly?
examples.zh: 跟其它的比，法国护照有多难看啊。

examples.en: It's not the person that's ugly, but the clothes.
examples.zh: 难看的不是人的外貌，而是人的衣服。

examples.en: "You're ugly." "Your mom is ugly." "Your mom's face is ugly."
examples.zh: “你很丑。”“你妈妈很丑。”“你妈妈的脸很丑。”

words.tran: 把…弄成难看；将…丑化；糟蹋

syno.tran: 丑陋的；邪恶的；令人厌恶的

phrase.cn: 丑小鸭；小时难看长大后变得才貌出众的人

ultimate.definition: n. the finest or most superior quality of its kind\na. furthest or highest in degree or order; utmost or extreme\ns. being the last or concluding element of a series
ultimate.translation: n. 终极, 根本, 顶点, 基本原则\na. 终极的, 根本的, 极限的, 最远的, 最后的, 最大的

examples.en: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
examples.zh: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。

examples.en: What is the ultimate purpose of education?
examples.zh: 教育的最终目的到底是什么?

words.tran: 最后通牒；最后结论；基本原理

syno.tran: 最终的；[物]极限的；根本的

phrase.cn: 极限承载力，极限承载量；轴承极限能力，承载量

ultimately.definition: r. as the end result of a succession or process
ultimately.translation: adv. 最后, 最终\n[法] 最后, 终究, 总之

examples.en: Her line of reasoning is attractive, but ultimately fallacious.
examples.zh: 她说理的主线引人注目，但从根本上是靠不住的。

umbrella.definition:
n. a lightweight handheld collapsible canopy
n. a formation of military planes maintained over ground operations or targets
n. having the function of uniting a group of similar things
s. covering or applying simultaneously to a number of similar items or elements or groups
umbrella.translation: n. 伞, 雨伞, 保护伞\na. 伞的, 包罗万象的\nvt. 用伞遮掩

examples.en: Don't forget to take an umbrella in case it rains.
examples.zh: 如果下雨的话，别忘了带把伞。

examples.en: Tom found Mary's umbrella in the trunk of his car.
examples.zh: 汤姆在车厢里找到玛丽的雨伞。

examples.en: I'm really sorry. I seem to have lost your umbrella.
examples.zh: 我真的很抱歉，我好像弄丢了你的雨伞。

syno.tran: 雨伞；保护伞；庇护；伞形结构

phrase.cn: n. （美）遮阳伞（海滨或花园用的）

unable.definition: a. (usually followed by `to') not having the necessary means or skill or know-how\ns. (usually followed by `to') lacking necessary physical or mental ability
unable.translation: a. 不能的, 不会的\n[法] 无能力的, 无资格的, 没有办法的

examples.en: I am unable to walk as fast as he can.
examples.zh: 我走得没他快。

examples.en: He was so angry as to be unable to speak.
examples.zh: 他气得说不出话来了。

examples.en: I am sorry, we are unable to satisfy your demand.
examples.zh: 对不起，我们无法满足您的要求。

unanimous.definition: s in complete agreement\ns acting together as a single undiversified whole
unanimous.translation: a. 意见一致的, 无异议的

examples.en: The vote is unanimous.
examples.zh: 选举一致通过了。

examples.en: The election was unanimous.
examples.zh: 选举一致通过了。

syno.tran: 全体一致的；意见一致的；无异议的

unbearable.definition: a incapable of being put up with
unbearable.translation: a. 无法忍受的, 承受不住的

examples.en: Dan left Linda when life became unbearable with her.
examples.zh: Dan离开了Linda，因为已经没法和她一起过日子了。

examples.en: The stomach pains are unbearable.
examples.zh: 胃疼得难以忍受。

examples.en: The pain is unbearable.
examples.zh: 疼痛令人难以忍受。

uncertain.definition:
a. lacking or indicating lack of confidence or assurance
a. not established beyond doubt; still undecided or unknown
a. not certain to occur; not inevitable
s. not consistent or dependable
uncertain.translation: a. 不确定的, 无常的, 不确信的, 不可预测的\n[法] 不确定的, 未定的, 不确信的

examples.en: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.
examples.zh: 我不确定该前进还是后退。

examples.en: Whether the medicine will work or not is uncertain.
examples.zh: 药物的作用还不确定。

examples.en: Tom is still uncertain about whether to go to college or not.
examples.zh: 汤姆还不清楚要不要上大学。

words.tran: 不确定地；没把握地；犹豫地

syno.tran: 无常的；含糊的；靠不住的；迟疑不决的

uncle.definition: n. the brother of your father or mother; the husband of your aunt\nn. a source of help and advice and encouragement
uncle.translation: n. 叔父, 伯父, 姨丈

examples.en: My uncle comes to see me from time to time.
examples.zh: 我叔叔偶尔来看我。

examples.en: Mommy, why don't I have an uncle with a beard?
examples.zh: 妈妈，为什么我没有长胡子的舅舅呢？

examples.en: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.
examples.zh: 在那儿看报纸的男人是我叔叔。

uncover.definition: v. make visible\nv. remove all or part of one's clothes to show one's body
uncover.translation: vt. 揭露, 揭开, 暴露, 脱帽致敬\nvi. 脱帽致敬, 揭去盖子

examples.en: I dare not probe too deeply, lest I uncover the awful truth!
examples.zh: 我不敢探查得太深, 以免发现可怕的事实。

words.tran: 无覆盖物的；[保险] 未保险的；无盖的
揭露（uncover的过去分词）；脱帽致敬；移去覆盖物

under.definition:
s. lower in rank, power, or authority
r. down to defeat, death, or ruin
r. through a range downward
r. into unconsciousness
under.translation: prep. 在...之下, 低于\na. 下面的, 从属的\nadv. 在下面

examples.en: Tom ran to his room and hid under the bed.
examples.zh: 汤姆跑进了他的房间，躲到了他的床底下。

examples.en: Is the cat on the chair or under the chair?
examples.zh: 猫在椅子上面，还是在椅子下面呢？

examples.en: He said to her under his breath, "I love you."
examples.zh: 他压低嗓门对她说：「我爱你。」

underestimate.definition: n. an estimation that is too low; an estimate that is less than the true or actual value\nv. make too low an estimate of
underestimate.translation: n. 低估\nvt. 低估, 看轻

examples.en: Don't underestimate your own strength.
examples.zh: 不要低估自己的实力。

examples.en: Don't underestimate my power.
examples.zh: 不要小看我的力量。

examples.en: Don't ever underestimate Tom.
examples.zh: 千万不可低估汤姆。

undergo.translation: vt. 遭受, 经历, 忍受\n[法] 经受, 经历, 忍受

examples.en: Father is going to undergo an operation.
examples.zh: 父亲将会接受手术。

examples.en: He underwent severe criticism.
examples.zh: 他被严历批评。

undergraduate.definition: n. a university student who has not yet received a first degree
undergraduate.translation: n. 大学本科生, 大学肄业生\na. 大学生的

examples.en: The student wing houses separate lounges for undergraduate and graduate students.
Postgraduate research is much more demanding than research at undergraduate level.
He is an undergraduate in the law department.

phrase.cn: 大学本科；颁发学士学位的学院

underground.definition: n. a secret group organized to overthrow a government or occupation force\nr. in or into hiding or secret operation\nr. beneath the surface of the earth
underground.translation: n. 地下, 地铁, 地道, 秘密活动\na. 地下的, 秘密的\nadv. 在地下, 秘密地

examples.en: Tom stood on the platform in Westminster Underground Station.
examples.zh: 汤姆站在威斯敏斯特地铁站的站台上。

examples.en: In Britain they call the subway the underground.
examples.zh: 英国人把“subway”叫做“underground”。

examples.en: To broaden your view, go see the underground shopping mall beneath People's Square.
examples.zh: 再要开眼界，去看人民广场下面的地下商场。

syno.tran: 地下的；秘密的；先锋派的
地下；地铁；地道；地下组织；秘密活动；先锋派团体

underlie.definition: v. be or form the base for\nv. lie underneath
underlie.translation: vt. 位于...之下, 成为...的基础

examples.en: Hatred underlies most relationships between men and women in America.
What reasoning could underlie their latest decision?
Who knows what disagreements underlie this agreement?

underline.definition: v. draw a line or lines underneath to call attention to
underline.translation: vt. 在...下面划线, 作...的衬里, 强调\nn. 下划线, 图下说明文字\n[计] 加下划线; 下划线

examples.en: Correct the underlined words.
examples.zh: 请改正划线字词。

examples.en: Translate the underlined part.
examples.zh: 翻译划线部分。

undermine.definition: v destroy property or hinder normal operations\nv hollow out as if making a cave or opening
undermine.translation: vt. 在...下面挖, 渐渐破坏, 暗地里破坏\n[法] 暗中破坏, 以阴谋中伤伤害

examples.en: The CIA used false flag operations to undermine Mohammad Mosaddegh.
The English teacher's derogatory comments undermine the confidence of foreign students.
No one can undermine your impact at work.

syno.tran: 破坏，渐渐破坏；挖掘地基

underneath.definition: r. on the lower or downward side; on the underside of\nr. under or below an object or a surface; at a lower place or level; directly beneath
underneath.translation: adv. 在下面\nprep. 在...的下面

examples.en: Underneath we wrote the names of the students in our class.
examples.zh: 下面写上我们班同学的名字。

examples.en: I found the key underneath the mat.
examples.zh: 我在擦鞋垫下面发现了这把钥匙。

understand.definition:
v. know and comprehend the nature or meaning of
v. perceive (an idea or situation) mentally
v. make sense of a language
v. believe to be the case
understand.translation: vt. 理解, 了解, 领会, 听说, 懂\nvi. 懂得, 认为

examples.en: If I could understand it, I would tell you so.
examples.zh: 如果我了解这件事, 我就会告诉你。

examples.en: I understand it a little, but I can't speak it.
examples.zh: 能听懂一点儿，但是不会讲。

examples.en: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
examples.zh: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

undertake.definition:
v. enter upon an activity or enterprise
v. accept as a challenge
v. promise to do or accomplish
v. accept as a charge
undertake.translation: vt. 试图, 从事, 保证, 承担, 同意, 接受\n[化] 承包; 承担

examples.en: He is too young to undertake this work.
examples.zh: 他太年轻，无法胜任这项工作。

words.tran: 承担者；承办人；殡仪业者

syno.tran: 承担，保证；从事；同意；试图

undo.definition: v. cancel, annul, or reverse an action or its effect\nv. cause the ruin or downfall of
undo.translation: vt. 解开, 取消, 破坏, 毁灭, 扰乱\nvi. 松开\n[计] 撤消

examples.en: Wait a minute. My shoelace is undone.
examples.zh: 等下，我鞋带散了。

examples.en: I can't undo it.
examples.zh: 我不能取消它。

examples.en: What is done cannot be undone.
examples.zh: 覆水难收。

words.tran: 破灭的；未完成的；解开的

undoubtedly.translation: adv. 无疑, 必定, 确实地

examples.en: The computer is undoubtedly a valuable tool.
examples.zh: 电脑无疑是一项有价值的工具。

examples.en: All these new blocks will undoubtedly impact the loading speed of the home page.
examples.zh: 这些新模块毫无疑问会影响主页的加载速度。

examples.en: Algeria has undoubtedly beautiful beaches.
examples.zh: 阿尔及利亚无疑拥有美丽的海滩。

unemployment.definition: n. the state of being unemployed or not having a job
unemployment.translation: n. 失业, 失业人数\n[经] 失业

examples.en: The unemployment rate went up to 5% because of the recession.
examples.zh: 经济不景气失业率上升到了5％。

examples.en: The unemployment rate in Japan was 3.4 percent in September of 2015.
examples.zh: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。

examples.en: The best way to solve unemployment is to work.
examples.zh: 解决失业最好的办法是去工作

unfair.definition: a. not fair; marked by injustice or partiality or deception
unfair.translation: a. 不公平的, 不正直的, 不正当的\n[法] 不正直的, 不公平的, 偏颇的

examples.en: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.
examples.zh: 我们这样待他，好像不是太好。

examples.en: You should've rejected such an unfair proposal.
examples.zh: 你本该拒绝一个那么不公平的提议。

examples.en: That was really unfair.
examples.zh: 那真不公平。

unfold.definition: v. open to the view\nv. extend or stretch out to a greater or the full length\nv. spread out or open from a closed or folded state
unfold.translation: vt. 展开, 打开, 披露, 开展, 挑明\nvi. 伸展, 开花, 呈现

examples.en: I watched what was unfolding in front of my eyes with bated breath.
examples.zh: 我屏气观看眼前光景。

unfortunate.definition: n. a person who suffers misfortune\na. not favored by fortune; marked or accompanied by or resulting in ill fortune\ns. unsuitable or regrettable
unfortunate.translation: a. 不幸的, 不合适的, 不吉利的

examples.en: It's really unfortunate. You don't understand at all its essence.
examples.zh: 太可惜了，你一点也不懂它的精髓。

examples.en: Due to a number of unfortunate causes, one-parent families are on the increase.
examples.zh: 由于诸多不幸因素，单亲家庭在增长中。

examples.en: Yesterday there was an unfortunate accident.
examples.zh: 昨天发生了一个不幸的事故。

unfortunately.translation: adv. 恐怕, 不幸的是

examples.en: Unfortunately I was not in time for his speech.
examples.zh: 很不幸，我没来得及听他的演讲。

examples.en: Unfortunately, Tom did what you told him not to.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，你禁止汤姆做的事，他仍然去做。

examples.en: Unfortunately, I have to get up early every morning.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，我必须每天早起。

words.tran: 不幸的；令人遗憾的；不成功的

uniform.definition:
n. clothing of distinctive design worn by members of a particular group as a means of identification
v. provide with uniforms
a. always the same; showing a single form or character in all occurrences
s. evenly spaced
uniform.translation: n. 制服\na. 统一的, 一律的, 始终如一的

examples.en: The New York City police wear a dark blue uniform.
examples.zh: 纽约警察穿深蓝色制服。

examples.en: The girl in a white uniform took my temperature.
examples.zh: 有个穿白色制服的女孩帮我量了体温。

examples.en: Some spaghetti fell on the badge of the uniform, dirtying it.
examples.zh: 有一些意面掉到了制服上的徽章那儿，把那边弄脏了。

words.tran: 使穿制服（或军服）；使成一样（uniform的过去式）
使一律；使均匀；使始终如一

syno.tran: 统一的；一致的；相同的；均衡的；始终如一的

unify.translation: v. 统一, 使成一体

examples.en: He tried to unify the various groups.
examples.zh: 他试著统一不同的团体。

words.tran: 统一；使一致（unify的过去分词）

union.definition:
n. an organization of employees formed to bargain with the employer
n. the United States (especially the northern states during the American Civil War)
n. the state of being joined or united or linked
n. healing process involving the growing together of the edges of a wound or the growing together of broken bones
union.translation: n. 联盟, 联合, 结合, 工会\n[化] 联合; 联管节; 活接头

examples.en: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.
examples.zh: 冷战以苏联解体结束。

examples.en: Communism is the system practiced in the Soviet Union.
examples.zh: 共产主义是在苏联被实行的制度。

examples.en: The union and the company have agreed upon a new contract.
examples.zh: 工会和企业一致同意了一份新的合同。

words.tran: 组织成工会的；[物][化学] 未电离的
工会主义；联合主义；联邦主义
使…成立联盟；使…加入工会（unionize的过去分词）
使……加入工会；使……成立工会

phrase.cn: 前苏联（1922-1991，首都莫斯科Moscow，位于欧、亚洲）
学生会；大学的学生活动大楼

unique.definition: s. (followed by `to') applying exclusively to a given category or condition or locality\ns. highly unusual or rare but not the single instance
unique.translation: a. 独一无二的, 独特的, 稀罕的

examples.en: The weather here has its own unique characteristics.
examples.zh: 这里的天气有独一无二的特点。

examples.en: Each and every person is unique.
examples.zh: 每一个人都是独一无二的。

examples.en: These flowers have a unique smell.
examples.zh: 这些花有一种独特的气味。

words.tran: 独特性；独一无二；单值性

syno.tran: 独特的，稀罕的；[数]唯一的，独一无二的

phrase.cn: 唯一机会；极难得的机会

unit.definition:
n. an individual or group or structure or other entity regarded as a structural or functional constituent of a whole
n. an organization regarded as part of a larger social group
n. a single undivided whole
n. a single undivided natural thing occurring in the composition of something else
unit.translation: n. 单位, 分队, 部队, 单元, 部件, 装置\na. 单位的, 单元的\n[计] 单元常数; 部件

examples.en: A vector is a unit vector if its norm is 1.
examples.zh: 模为1的向量是单位向量。

examples.en: At that moment, the telephone in the unit office rang.
examples.zh: 那时，分队办公室里电话响了。

examples.en: The family is the fundamental unit of society.
examples.zh: 家庭是社会的核心。

words.tran: 单元化；联合经营；统一化
使成为一单位；使成一整体；单元化

syno.tran: [计量]单位，单元；装置；[军]部队；[机]部件

unite.definition:
v. act in concert or unite in a common purpose or belief
v. have or possess in combination
v. bring together for a common purpose or action or ideology or in a shared situation
v. join or combine
unite.translation: vi. 联合, 接合, 混合\nvt. 使联合, 统一, 使粘合, 使结合

examples.en: Oceans do not so much divide the world as unite it.
examples.zh: 海洋不是将世界分隔开来，而是将世界连接起来

examples.en: When man and woman unite, work is no longer as tiring.
examples.zh: 男女搭配，干活不累。

examples.en: Karl Marx said: "Workers of the world, unite!"
examples.zh: 卡尔马克思说了：“全世界无产者，联合起来！”

words.tran: 一致的，统一的；团结的，和睦的
团结一致地；联合在一起地
使团结；使联合；使结婚（unite的现在分词）

unity.definition: n an undivided or unbroken completeness or totality with nothing wanting\nn the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number\nn the quality of being united into one
unity.translation: n. 一致, 联合, 单一(性), 个体\n[经] 统一

examples.en: Unity, justice and freedom are the pledge of fortune.
examples.zh: 团结、公正和自由是幸福的保证。

words.tran: 一致的，统一的；团结的，和睦的
团结一致地；联合在一起地
使团结；使联合；使结婚（unite的现在分词）

phrase.cn: 团结就是力量；众志成城

universal.definition:
n. (linguistics) a grammatical rule (or other linguistic feature) that is found in all languages
n. (logic) a proposition that asserts something of all members of a class
n. a behavioral convention or pattern characteristic of all members of a particular culture or of all human beings
s. applicable to or common to all members of a group or set
universal.translation: a. 全世界的, 普遍的, 宇宙的, 通用的\nn. 一般概念

examples.en: English is a universal language and is used all over the world.
examples.zh: 英语是一种世界性的语言，用于世界各地。

examples.en: English is a kind of universal language.
examples.zh: 英语是一种世界语言。

words.tran: 普遍性；广泛性；一般性；多方面性
普遍主义；普遍性；普救论
信普救说者；普遍主义者

syno.tran: 普遍的；通用的；[天]宇宙的；全世界的；全体的

phrase.cn: 通用语言；世界语；人人都理解的事物

universe.definition: n. everything that exists anywhere\nn. everything stated or assumed in a given discussion
universe.translation: n. 宇宙, 星系, (思想等)范围

examples.en: Our world is only a small part of the universe.
examples.zh: 我们的世界只不过是宇宙的一小部分。

examples.en: Our world is only one small part of the universe.
examples.zh: 我们的世界只不过是宇宙的一小部分。

examples.en: The age of the universe is about 13.75 billion years.
examples.zh: 宇宙的年龄大约为137.5亿年。

words.tran: 普遍的；通用的；宇宙的；全世界的；全体的

phrase.cn: n. 论域；讨论或辩论的范围

university.definition: n. the body of faculty and students at a university\nn. establishment where a seat of higher learning is housed, including administrative and living quarters as well as facilities for research and teaching\nn. a large and diverse institution of higher learning created to educate for life and for a profession and to grant degrees

examples.en: Isn't he a graduate student at the University of Rome?
examples.zh: 他不是罗马大学的研究生吗?

examples.en: My sister is 20 years old. She is a university student.
examples.zh: 我妹妹二十岁。她是大学生。

examples.en: I'm not a university student, but I'm brighter than them.
examples.zh: 我不是一个大学生, 但我比他们更聪明。

unless.definition:
conj. Upon any less condition than (the fact or thing stated
   in the sentence or clause which follows); if not; supposing that not;
   if it be not; were it not that; except; as, we shall fail unless we are
   industrious.

examples.en: I'll expect you tomorrow unless you let me know otherwise.
examples.zh: 你不改口的话，我明天就来等你了。

examples.en: You don't need to go unless you want to.
examples.zh: 你不想去的话不必去。

examples.en: You don't have to go unless you want to.
examples.zh: 你不想去就别去。

unlike.definition: a. marked by dissimilarity\na. not equal in amount
unlike.translation: a. 不像的, 不同的\nprep. 不像, 和...不同

examples.en: The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
examples.zh: 不像狗, 这只鹤从来没有梦想过飞翔。

examples.en: The two brothers are quite unlike in their appearance.
examples.zh: 哥哥和弟弟的样子一点也不像。

examples.en: It's unlike him to get so angry.
examples.zh: 这么生气不像他。

words.tran: 不可信；未必有；不大可能的事

unlikely.definition: a. has little chance of being the case or coming about

examples.en: I think that it's unlikely that Tom will get elected.
examples.zh: 我觉得汤姆不太可能会当选。

examples.en: I think it's unlikely that Tom will get elected.
examples.zh: 我觉得汤姆不太可能会当选。

examples.en: I think that it's unlikely Tom will get elected.
examples.zh: 我觉得汤姆不太可能会当选。

words.tran: 不可信；未必有；不大可能的事

unload.definition: v. take the load off (a container or vehicle)
unload.translation: vi. 卸货\nvt. 从...卸下, 摆脱...之负担, 倾销, 卸(货)\n[计] 卸载

examples.en: I won't unload the car because that's somebody else's job.
How many boxes did you unload from the truck?
Tom started to unload the sacks from the truck.

unprecedented.translation: a. 空前的\n[经] 空前的, 无前例的

examples.en: The unprecedented drought did severe damage to the wheat harvest.
The tears she'd been holding back exploded with unprecedented force.
This winter began with an unprecedented amount of snow.

until.definition:
prep. To; unto; towards; -- used of material objects.
prep. To; up to; till; before; -- used of time; as, he staid
   until evening; he will not come back until the end of the month.
conj. As far as; to the place or degree that; especially, up to
   the time that; till. See Till, conj.
until.translation: prep. 直到, 在...以前\nconj. 直到...时, 在...以前

examples.en: I want you to stay here until I get back.
examples.zh: 我想你待在这里直到我回来。

examples.en: I'm not going to tell you until I tell Tom.
examples.zh: 我没告诉汤姆，就不会告诉你。

examples.en: We made good time until we ran into a blizzard.
examples.zh: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。

unusual.definition: a. not usual or common or ordinary\ns. not commonly encountered
unusual.translation: a. 不寻常的, 罕见的, 与众不同的

examples.en: "So how do you find Mary?" "She looks rather unusual."
examples.zh: ”那你怎么看玛丽？“ “她看起来挺异常的。”

examples.en: The house stood out because of its unusual shape.
examples.zh: 那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。

examples.en: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
examples.zh: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。

words.tran: 非常；异乎寻常地；显著地

syno.tran: 不寻常的；与众不同的；不平常的

update.definition:
n. news that updates your information
v. modernize or bring up to date
v. bring up to date; supply with recent information
v. bring to the latest state of technology
update.translation: vt. 更新, 使现代化\nn. 更新\n[计] 更新

examples.en: Could I get you to update this data for me?
examples.zh: 你可以帮我更新这份资料吗？

examples.en: My PC is in the middle of an update.
examples.zh: 我的电脑正在更新。

examples.en: This update will be released at 10 o'clock this morning.
examples.zh: 这个更新会在今天上午10点发布。

syno.tran: 更新；校正，修正；使现代化

upgrade.definition:
n. software that provides better performance than an earlier version did
n. a reservation that is improved
n. the property possessed by a slope or surface that rises
n. hardware that provides better performance than an earlier version did
upgrade.translation:
n. 上坡, 升级, 上升
adv. 往上
vt. 使升级, 提升, 改良品种
vi. 升级
[计] 升级

examples.en: You can upgrade your computer with more random access memory to make the PC faster.
examples.zh: 您可以使用更多任何存取记忆体来升级您的电脑，以提高 PC 的运行速度。

examples.en: With this upgrade, one obvious impact is that users will be obliged to reset their passwords.
examples.zh: 这次升级的一个明显影响是用户会被强制重置密码。

uphold.definition: v. stand up for; stick up for; of causes, principles, or ideals\nv. support against an opponent
uphold.translation: vt. 支撑, 赞成, 鼓励, 举起, 坚持\n[法] 确认, 赞成, 支持

examples.en: Many people uphold the stance that 95% of DNA is junk.
Where's everyone who swore to uphold and defend the Constitution?
Many people still uphold traditions even though it means suffering.

upon.definition: prep. On; -- used in all the senses of that word, with which it\n   is interchangeable.
upon.translation: prep. 在...之上, 迫近, 紧接着

examples.en: It fell upon me to take care of my mother.
examples.zh: 照顾母亲的责任落在了我身上。

examples.en: The rich are apt to look down upon the poor.
examples.zh: 富人往往瞧不起穷人。

examples.en: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒的味道很受天气影响。

upper.definition:
n. piece of leather or synthetic material that forms the part of a shoe or boot above the sole that encases the foot
s. the topmost one of two
s. higher in place or position
s. superior in rank or accomplishment
upper.translation: a. 上面的, 较高的, 上级的, 上院的, 穿在外面的, 北部的, 地表的, 后期的\nn. 鞋帮, 上齿

examples.en: The upper reaches of the river are very beautiful.
examples.zh: 河的上游很美。

examples.en: He thought he had the upper hand, but I turned the tables on him.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己占了上风，但我反过来扭转了局面。

examples.en: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
examples.zh: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。

words.tran: 至上的；最高的；最主要的
最高地；最重要地；最突出地

syno.tran: [流][地质]上面的，上部的；较高的

upright.definition: n. a vertical structural member as a post or stake\nn. a piano with a vertical sounding board\ns. in a vertical position; not sloping
upright.translation: a. 正直的, 诚实的, 公正的, 垂直的, 竖式的\n[化] 立杆

examples.en: Even after it was hit, the pole was still upright.
Lukas was driving in a very stiff and upright position.
Dmitri was standing upright in the middle of the field.

syno.tran: 正直的，诚实的；垂直的，直立的；笔直的；合乎正道的

uproar.definition: n a state of commotion and noise and confusion\nn loud confused noise from many sources

examples.en: On the day of my birthday, my friends made me drink and I caused quite an uproar.
examples.zh: 在我生日那天，朋友让我喝酒，我大闹一番。

upset.definition:
n. the act of disturbing the mind or body
n. a tool used to thicken or spread metal (the end of a bar or a rivet etc.) by forging or hammering or swaging
n. the act of upsetting something
v. disturb the balance or stability of
upset.translation: a. 弄翻的, 混乱的, 心烦的\nvt. 弄翻, 颠覆, 推翻, 打乱, 使不适, 使心烦\nvi. 翻倒

examples.en: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
examples.zh: 自从公司合并了以后，一切都变得十分混乱。

examples.en: Sometimes being overcautious in planning could upset the apple cart.
examples.zh: 计划时如果过于谨慎的话，可能会反把计划搞乱。

examples.en: I didn't think that Tom would be so upset.
examples.zh: 我认为，汤姆不会这么生气的。

words.tran: 令人心烦意乱的，令人苦恼的

phrase.cn: n. 肠胃不适，消化不良

examples.en: He was looking upward to the sky.
examples.zh: 他抬头望著天空。

examples.en: The smoke went upward through the chimney.
examples.zh: 烟从烟囱里冒了出来。

phrase.cn: 上压力；向上压力；反向压力

urban.definition: a. relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area\na. located in or characteristic of a city or city life
urban.translation: a. 都市的, 住在都市的, 习惯于都市的\n[法] 城市的, 都市的, 市区的

examples.en: More and more people are moving to urban areas.
examples.zh: 越来越多的人迁往市区。

examples.en: What are the characteristics of this new type of urban life?
examples.zh: 这种新型的城市生活有什么特点？

examples.en: What's new about this way of urban living?
examples.zh: 这种新型的城市生活有什么特点？

words.tran: 彬彬有礼的，温文尔雅的；都市化的

urge.definition: n. an instinctive motive\nn. a strong restless desire\nv. force or impel in an indicated direction
urge.translation: n. 冲动, 推动力, 迫切的要求\nvt. 驱策, 力劝, 竭力主张, 推动\nvi. 强烈要求

examples.en: Lawyers will urge the parents to take further legal action.
examples.zh: 律师们会力劝家长们采取进一步的法律行动。

examples.en: I urge you to tell him the truth.
examples.zh: 我劝你告诉他实话。

examples.en: Advertisements urge us to buy luxuries.
examples.zh: 广告怂恿我们买奢侈品。

syno.tran: 强烈的欲望，迫切要求；推动力

urgent.translation: a. 紧急的, 急迫的, 催逼的\n[经] 紧急的, 急迫的

examples.en: If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.
examples.zh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。

examples.en: There is an urgent need for medical supplies.
examples.zh: 急需医疗用品。

examples.en: I have an urgent message from Tom.
examples.zh: 我收到汤姆的一条紧急消息。

usage.definition: n. the customary manner in which a language (or a form of a language) is spoken or written
usage.translation: n. 用法, 使用, 习惯, 惯用法, 习惯法\n[经] 使用情况, 使用用途, 惯例

examples.en: The proliferation of Internet usage has given birth to a new generation of young people.
examples.zh: 互联网的广泛应用使新一代的年轻人诞生了。

examples.en: To give a definition of a word is more difficult than to give an illustration of its usage.
examples.zh: 要为一个字下定义比为字的用法举例更困难。

words.tran: 有用的，有益的；有帮助的
习惯的；二手的，使用过的
可用的；便于使用的（等于usable）

phrase.cn: 使用时间；通信传输时间

use.definition:
n. the act of using
n. a particular service
n. (law) the exercise of the legal right to enjoy the benefits of owning property
v. put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose
use.translation: n. 使用, 习惯, 使用价值, 用法, 使用权\nvt. 使用, 利用, 运用, 耗费\nvi. 惯常

examples.en: I use a frying pan at least once a day.
examples.zh: 我每天至少用一次煎锅。

examples.en: I need a pencil. Can I use one of yours?
examples.zh: 我需要一支铅笔，我能用你的其中一支吗？

examples.en: I don't know how to use an art file (.art).
examples.zh: 我不知道如何使用.art文件。

useful.definition: a. being of use or service
useful.translation: a. 有用的, 有益的\n[机] 有用的, 有效的

examples.en: I'm glad I was able to be useful to you.
examples.zh: 我很高兴我能帮助到你。

examples.en: He only buys things that will be useful to him.
examples.zh: 他只买对他会有用的东西。

examples.en: Read such books as will be useful in later life.
examples.zh: 读这样的书会对今后的生活会有用。

useless.definition: a. having no beneficial use or incapable of functioning usefully
useless.translation: a. 无用的, 无效的, 无益的\n[机] 无用, 无价值, 无效

examples.en: It's useless, I'm not motivated today for some reason.
examples.zh: 不行，今天不知为何没有干劲。

examples.en: Threatening me is useless, I won't say anything.
examples.zh: 威胁我也没用，我什么都不会说的。

examples.en: For once in my life I'm doing a good deed... And it is useless.
examples.zh: 我生平难得做了一件好事...却是没用的。

user.definition: n. a person who makes use of a thing; someone who uses or employs something
user.translation: n. 使用者\n[计] 用户

examples.en: Many of the user reviews on Amazon are fake.
examples.zh: 亚马逊网站上的许多用户评论都是虚假的。

examples.en: The reimagined user interface allows smoother play across devices.
examples.zh: 全新设计的操作介面能让玩家在各种装置上享受更流畅的体验。

examples.en: Would you like to become a trusted user?
examples.zh: 你要不要成为可信赖用户？

usual.definition: a. occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure
usual.translation: a. 平常的, 通常的

examples.en: This morning I got up an hour earlier than usual.
examples.zh: 今早我比平时早了一个小时起床。

examples.en: We give here a list of the usual Esperanto-related questions.
examples.zh: 我们在这里罗列了常见的有关世界语的问题。

examples.en: He put the key on the desk as usual.
examples.zh: 他跟平时一样把钥匙放在书桌上。

utility.definition:
n. a company that performs a public service; subject to government regulation
n. the quality of being of practical use
n. the service (electric power or water or transportation) provided by a public utility
n. (economics) a measure that is to be maximized in any situation involving choice
utility.translation: n. 功用, 有用之物, 实用, 公用事业, 实用程序\na. 实用的, 有多种用途的\n[计] 实用程序, 工具

examples.en: Mary made her own ripped jeans with a utility knife.
We have already been warned that utility rates will rise.
Have you already been warned that utility rates will rise?

syno.tran: 实用；效用；公共设施；功用
实用的；通用的；有多种用途的

phrase.cn: 实用新型（约十个国家法律承认的一种保护发明名称，期限五年）
公用设施；公用事业公司

utilize.definition: v. convert (from an investment trust to a unit trust)

examples.en: Tom utilized some wooden chests as chairs.
examples.zh: 汤姆把几个木箱子当椅子用。

utmost.translation: n. 极限, 最大限度, 极度\na. 极度的, 最远的

examples.en: This is a matter of the utmost importance.
examples.zh: 这件事至关重要。

examples.en: I see him eating and sleeping, sleeping and eating, playing games whenever, lazy in the utmost!
examples.zh: 我看他，吃了又睡，睡了又吃，游戏打了又打，懒得不得了！

examples.en: We must make the utmost effort to reduce the use of plastic packaging, and also to recycle all waste plastic.
examples.zh: 我们应该尽我们最大的努力减少塑料包装的使用，并回收所有的塑料废物。

utter.definition: v. express audibly; utter sounds (not necessarily words)\nv. put into circulation
utter.translation: a. 全然的, 绝对的, 完全的\nvt. 发出声音, 做声, 发表, 发射, 流通

examples.en: He was too embarrassed to utter a word in front of the crowd.
examples.zh: 他太难为情，在大众人前一句话也说不出来。

words.tran: 完全地；绝对地；全然地；彻底地，十足地

syno.tran: 完全的；彻底的；无条件的

utterance.definition: n. the use of uttered sounds for auditory communication
utterance.translation: n. 发声, 言辞, 表达, 说话的方式, 死\n[医] 发言, 言语, 语调

examples.en: What is the difference between a sentence and an utterance?
An utterance can be an element of the text.
Tom has naturally a very agreeable voice and utterance.

ulcer.definition: n. a circumscribed inflammatory and often suppurating lesion on the skin or an internal mucous surface resulting in necrosis of tissue
ulcer.translation: n. 溃疡, 腐烂物\n[医] 溃疡

examples.en: A woman in your situation could easily develop an ulcer.
In the hospital, Boldi was diagnosed with an ulcer.
I have aphthous ulcers on the back of my throat.

underlying.translation: a. 在下面的\n[经] 优先的, 基础的, 放在下面的

examples.en: The underlying causes of the problem are widely known.
examples.zh: 这个问题的根本原因广为人知。

examples.en: They used the Internet too much because they had some underlying problem that also caused them to neglect their child.
examples.zh: 他们是因为患有一种使他门忽视孩子的基础精神病而过于上网。

syno.tran: 潜在的；根本的；在下面的；优先的

phrase.cn: 标的资产；基础资产；相关/指定资产
[金融]标的证券；附属公司证券

ultra.definition: s (used of opinions and actions) far beyond the norm
ultra.translation: a. 过分的, 极端的\nn. 极端主义者, 过激论者, 急进论者

examples.en: The movie is out now on 4K Ultra.
The prices are ultra high on this ship.
To set the Texture Resolution to Ultra, you will require at least 8 GB of VRAM.

underdeveloped.translation: a. 开发不充分的, 不发达的, 发育不全的

examples.en: This area is still underdeveloped because of a lack of interest from the government.
examples.zh: 因为缺乏的政府的关注，这个区域还不发达。

undertaking.definition: n. any piece of work that is undertaken or attempted\nn. the trade of a funeral director
undertaking.translation: n. 事业, 企业, 保证\n[经] 企业, 事业, 承担

examples.en: He enthusiastically engaged himself in this honorable undertaking.
examples.zh: 她热忱地投身于这份光荣的事业。

words.tran: 承担者；承办人；殡仪业者
承担，保证；从事；同意；试图

uneasy.definition: a. lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance\ns. relating to bodily unease that causes discomfort
uneasy.translation: a. 心神不安的, 不自在的, 不稳定的, 不舒服的

examples.en: I write everything down; I feel uneasy without my notebook.
examples.zh: 我无论是甚么东西也要记进笔记本里；没有了笔记本，我就会浑身不自在。

examples.en: She felt uneasy at the thought of her future.
examples.zh: 想到自己的未来，她不安起来。

examples.en: I understand that you feel uneasy, but don't worry.
examples.zh: 我知道你不自在，但别急。

words.tran: 不自在地；不稳定地；心神不安地

syno.tran: 不舒服的；心神不安的；不稳定的

unemployed.definition: a. not engaged in a gainful occupation
unemployed.translation: a. 失业的, 未被利用的\n[经] 没有被雇用的, 失业的, 没有被利用的

examples.en: I hear that the number of the unemployed has been increasing recently.
examples.zh: 听说最近失业者人数正在增加

unilateral.definition: a. involving only one part or side\ns. tracing descent from either the paternal or the maternal line only
unilateral.translation: a. 单方面的, 单边的, 片面的\n[医] 单侧的, 一侧的

examples.en: I believe that "unilateral" relationships do not exist.
Tom's boss made a unilateral decision to close several small branches of the company.

unleash.definition: v. release or vent\nv. release from a leash\nv. turn loose or free from restraint
unleash.translation: vt. 解开...的皮带, 发出, 发动

examples.en: If a piece of knotted string can unleash the wind, and if a drowned man can awaken, then I believe a broken man can heal.
examples.zh: 如果一段打结的绳子能换来风，如果淹死的人能再醒来，那么我相信伤了心的人会痊愈。

unveil.definition: v. remove the veil from\nv. remove the cover from
unveil.translation: vt. 揭开, 揭幕, 除去...的面纱\nvi. 显露, 除去面纱

examples.en: The king’s portrait was unveiled to great applause.
examples.zh: 国王的肖像揭晓，收获了热烈的掌声。

examples.en: The portrait of the king was unveiled and received enthusiastic applause.
examples.zh: 国王的肖像揭晓，收获了热烈的掌声。

examples.en: Microsoft recently unveiled two new dual screen devices.
examples.zh: Microsoft 近期新推出了两款双萤幕装置。

uprising.definition:
n organized opposition to authority; a conflict in which one faction tries to wrest control from another
v come into existence; take on form or shape
v ascend as a sound
v rise up as in fear
v rise to one's feet
v come up, of celestial bodies
v move upward
v return from the dead
v get up and out of bed
uprising.translation: n. 起义, 升起\n[法] 起义, 暴动

examples.en: His analysis of the causes of the uprising was correct.
The government acted boldly to deal with the outlaw uprising.
Tom didn't know there was an uprising planned.

uranium.definition: n. a heavy toxic silvery-white radioactive metallic element; occurs in many isotopes; used for nuclear fuels and nuclear weapons

examples.en: Namibia is one of the world's largest producers of uranium.
We need to preserve democracy even with depleted uranium bombs.
Iran has significant reserves of coal, uranium, and other minerals.

urgency.definition: n. the state of being urgent; an earnest and insistent necessity\nn. pressing importance requiring speedy action\nn. an urgent situation calling for prompt action
urgency.translation: n. 紧急, 催促\n[法] 紧急, 迫切, 紧急之事

examples.en: This matter is of incredible urgency!
examples.zh: 这件事十万火急！

urinate.definition: v. pass after the manner of urine
urinate.translation: vi. 小便, 撒尿\n[医] 排尿

examples.en: When was the last time you urinated?
examples.zh: 你上次小便是什么时候？

examples.en: I have a problem urinating.
examples.zh: 我排尿有问题。

urine.translation: n. 小便, 尿\n[医] 尿

examples.en: What color is your urine: clear, dark yellow, reddish, or brown like beer?
examples.zh: 你的尿液是什么颜色的：浅色的、深黄色的、浅红色的还是像啤酒一样的咖啡色？

examples.en: We want to analyze your urine.
examples.zh: 我们想验一下您的尿液。

examples.en: I don't like dirty animals. Especially those animals that smear urine on their bodies.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢肮脏的动物。尤其是那些涂尿在身上的动物。

up-to-date.definition: s. reflecting the latest information or changes\ns. in accord with the most fashionable ideas or style
up-to-date.translation: a. 直到现在的, 最近的, 现代化的\n[化] 最新的

examples.en: The Waterfront project will help to keep Edinburgh up-to-date and bring more people to Scotland's capital city.
examples.zh: 水边地工程会帮助爱丁堡城市紧随形势并使更多人来苏格兰的首都。

syno.tran: 最新的，最近的；现代的，新式的

ultrasonic.definition: s having frequencies above those of audible sound
ultrasonic.translation: n. 超声波\na. 超音速的

ultraviolet.definition: n. radiation lying in the ultraviolet range; wave lengths shorter than light but longer than X rays\ns. having or employing wavelengths shorter than light but longer than X-rays; lying outside the visible spectrum at its violet end
ultraviolet.translation: a. 紫外线的\n[化] 紫外线的; 紫外线

examples.en: The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
examples.zh: 平流层的臭氧会吸收紫外线。

examples.en: Ultraviolet rays can cause skin cancer.
examples.zh: 紫外线可导致皮肤癌。

unavoidable.definition: s impossible to avoid or evade:"inescapable conclusion"
unavoidable.translation: a. 不可避免的, 不得已的, 不能作废的\n[医] 难免的

examples.en: What happened here was unavoidable.
examples.zh: 发生这事是免不了的。

uncomfortable.definition: a. conducive to or feeling mental discomfort\na. providing or experiencing physical discomfort
uncomfortable.translation: a. 不舒服的, 不自在的, 不安的

examples.en: I am ready to die. I hope it's not too uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 我准备好迎接死亡了。我希望别太难受。

examples.en: I didn’t mean to make anyone uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 我没想让人感到不适。

examples.en: I felt cold and uncomfortable the entire night.
examples.zh: 我整个晚上觉得又冷又不舒服。

unconscious.definition: a. not conscious; lacking awareness and the capacity for sensory perception as if asleep or dead\ns. without conscious volition\ns. (followed by `of') not knowing or perceiving
unconscious.translation: a. 未意识到的, 无意识的, 无知觉的\n[医] 人事不省的, 神志丧失的; 无意识的

examples.en: He was discovered unconscious on the floor of the kitchen.
examples.zh: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。

examples.en: He was found lying unconscious on the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。

unconventional.definition: a. not conforming to accepted rules or standards\na. not conventional or conformist
unconventional.translation: a. 不依惯例的, 非传统的, 非常规的

examples.en: We need an attorney with experience in unconventional means.
She has an unconventional approach to solving math problems.
I have a taste for the unconventional.

understanding.definition: n. the cognitive condition of someone who understands\ns. characterized by understanding based on comprehension and discernment and empathy
understanding.translation: n. 理解, 谅解\n[法] 协商, 协议, 谅解

examples.en: Before understanding the situation clearly, he hastily gave his opinion.
examples.zh: 他还没有把情况了解清楚就急忙发表意见。

examples.en: He who is slow to anger has great understanding.
examples.zh: 不轻易发怒的，大有聪明。

examples.en: It's good for our understanding of other cultures.
examples.zh: 它有利于我们理解其他文化。

underwear.definition: n. undergarment worn next to the skin and under the outer garments

examples.en: Recently, this brand launched a series of limited edition underwear.
examples.zh: 最近这个品牌推出了一系列限量版内衣。

examples.en: Taobao suggested sexy and cute erotic underwear for me.
examples.zh: 淘宝给我推荐了性感又可爱的情趣内衣。

examples.en: I am not wearing any underwear.
examples.zh: 我没穿内衣。

undesirable.definition: n. one whose presence is undesirable\na. not wanted\ns. not worthy of being chosen (especially as a spouse)
undesirable.translation: a. 不受欢迎的, 不合乎社会道德标准的\n[法] 不受欢迎的人, 不良份子, 不法份子

examples.en: Ziri convinced Rima that she was ugly and undesirable.
This movie may have an undesirable influence on children.
Clinginess is an undesirable quality in a romantic partner.

unexpected.translation: a. 料想不到的, 突然的, 意外的\n[法] 不能预料的, 意外的

examples.en: Do not fear the unexpected, but be prepared for it.
examples.zh: 不要害怕意外，但要有准备。

examples.en: A slip of the tongue often brings about unexpected results.
examples.zh: 一时失言常常会带来意想不到的结果。

examples.en: Careful as he was, he made an unexpected mistake.
examples.zh: 虽然他很小心，但还是犯了个想不到的错误。

unfit.definition: a. below the required standards for a purpose\na. not in good physical or mental condition; out of condition
unfit.translation: a. 不适当的, 不胜任的, 不健康的\nvt. 使不相宜, 使不合格

examples.en: He is unfit to be a teacher.
examples.zh: 他不适合当老师。

unhappy.definition: a. experiencing or marked by or causing sadness or sorrow or discontent\ns. causing discomfort
unhappy.translation: a. 不快乐的, 不幸的, 不适当的

examples.en: The unhappy event made him put an end to himself.
examples.zh: 那件不幸的事故使他自杀身亡。

examples.en: I don't think that Tom knows that Mary is unhappy.
examples.zh: 我认为汤姆不知道玛丽不开心。

examples.en: Tom said that he thought Mary was unhappy in Boston.
examples.zh: 汤姆说他以为玛丽在波士顿不快乐。

uniformly.translation: adv. 一样, 一致, 相同, 一直不变, 一贯, 始终如一, 均质, 一律, 均匀\n[计] 均匀地

examples.en: Colonel Barclay's family life appears to have been a uniformly happy one.
Continue stirring until the chocolate chips are mixed uniformly through the cookie dough.

universally.translation: adv. 宇宙, 全世界, 普遍, 一般, 普通, 全体, 一致, 通用, 万能, 广用, 广泛

examples.en: That's a universally human experience that repeats over and over.
Minecraft has been a universally loved game for years.
You will be universally praised for speaking the truth.

unjust.translation: a. 不公平的\n[法] 不公正的人; 不公正的, 不公平的, 不合理的

examples.en: The rain falls on the just and the unjust alike.
Many unjust and bad things are done out of habit.
Women have been resigned to unjust treatment for too long.

unkind.translation: a. 不仁慈的, 不亲切的

examples.en: I would not want her to remember me with unkind words.
Why are you being so unkind to Tom?
I didn't expect Tom to be so unkind.

unknown.definition:
n. an unknown and unexplored region
n. a variable whose values are solutions of an equation
a. not known
s. not known to exist
unknown.translation: a. 不知道的, 未知的, 陌生的\nn. 未知物, 未知数

examples.en: The cause of the fire was unknown.
examples.zh: 火灾的原因不明。

examples.en: The suspect's gender is currently unknown.
examples.zh: 嫌疑犯目前性别不明。

examples.en: Flowers and wreaths were laid in front of the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
examples.zh: 在无名战士的墓前献上了鲜花和花圈。

unlimited.definition: a. having no limits in range or scope
unlimited.translation: a. 无限的, 不受限制的, 无条件的\n[经] 无限的, 不定的

examples.en: My plan covers unlimited calls to landlines, but not mobiles.
Tom is grandfathered in with an unlimited data plan.
"You have three wishes." "I wish for unlimited wishes."

unlock.definition: v. open the lock of\nv. set free or release\nv. become unlocked
unlock.translation: vt. 开...的锁, 开启, 表露, 放出\nvi. 被开启, 揭开, 解放\n[计] 解出锁定

examples.en: It was careless of you to leave the door unlocked.
examples.zh: 你没锁好门，真不小心呢。

examples.en: Mary said she wished she hadn't left the door unlocked.
examples.zh: 玛丽表示她希望她没忘了锁门。

examples.en: What does this key unlock?
examples.zh: 这钥匙能打开什么？

unlucky.translation: a. 不吉利的, 不祥的, 不幸的

examples.en: The number 4 is considered an unlucky number in Japan.
examples.zh: 四在日本是一个不幸的数字。

examples.en: Four is an unlucky number in Japan.
examples.zh: 4在日本是一个不幸的数字。

examples.en: 'Four' is an unlucky number in Japan.
examples.zh: 4在日本是一个不幸的数字。

examples.en: The facts proved that our worries were unnecessary.
examples.zh: 事实证明了我们的担心是多余的。

examples.en: If two men always have the same opinion, one of them is unnecessary.
examples.zh: 如果两个人总是意见相同，那么他们其中一个就没必要了。

examples.en: I believe this was unnecessary.
examples.zh: 我相信这是不必要的。

unorthodox.definition: a. breaking with convention or tradition
unorthodox.translation: a. 非正统的, 异教的

examples.en: There was much furore over Ms Chakraborty's unorthodox theories.
His unorthodox fighting style was surprisingly effective.
His teaching methods are highly unorthodox.

unpaid.translation: a. 未付款的, 不支薪水的\n[经] 未付的, 未缴纳的

examples.en: Youths who are caught violating the new rules on behaviour will lose their right to free travel, and will have to complete unpaid community work to earn it back.
examples.zh: 被判严重违反新的行为准则的青少年将失去免费乘坐公交车的权利，如果想重新取得必须做无报酬的社区工作。

unpleasant.definition: a. disagreeable to the senses, to the mind, or feelings
unpleasant.translation: a. 使人不愉快的, 使人厌恶的, 煞风景的

examples.en: The gas gives off a strong, unpleasant smell.
examples.zh: 这个气体散发出强烈难闻的气味。

examples.en: An unpleasant feeling is always bad.
examples.zh: 不愉快的感觉永远不好。

examples.en: We had an unpleasant experience there.
examples.zh: 我们在那里有一个不愉快的经历。

unreasonable.definition: a. not reasonable; not showing good judgment
unreasonable.translation: a. 不合理的, 过度的, 不切实际的\n[法] 不讲道理的, 非理智的, 不合理的

examples.en: There are always some people who are unreasonable.
examples.zh: 总有一些人不讲理。

examples.en: He's not an unreasonable man.
examples.zh: 他不是不讲理的人。

examples.en: No man has the imagination required to grasp female reason, which is why it is called unreasonable.
examples.zh: 没有男人有能把控住女性理性的想象力，这就是为什么它被说无理。

unreliable.definition: a. not worthy of reliance or trust\ns. lacking a sense of responsibility
unreliable.translation: a. 不可靠的\n[法] 不可靠的, 靠不住的

examples.en: They are unreliable.
examples.zh: 他们不可靠。

examples.en: I find the plan to be unsatisfactory in several ways.
It's not ideal, but it's the least unsatisfactory solution.
It isn't ideal, but it's the least unsatisfactory solution.

unstable.definition: a. lacking stability or fixity or firmness\ns. highly or violently reactive\ns. disposed to psychological variability

examples.en: People's emotional lives are becoming more and more unstable.
examples.zh: 人们的感情生活越来越不稳定。

examples.en: In consequence of some badly coded functions, the system is unstable most of the time.
examples.zh: 由于一些写得糟糕的函数，系统大多数情况下不稳定。

unsuitable.definition: s. not meant or adapted for a particular purpose\ns. not conducive to good moral development
unsuitable.translation: a. 不适合的\n[法] 不适合的, 不适当的

examples.en: The opacity of the glass made it unsuitable for windowpanes.
I think the translation of that word is unsuitable.
The unsuitable way you dress calls attention to you.

untie.definition: v. undo the ties of\nv. cause to become loose

examples.en: Wait a second. My shoe is untied.
examples.zh: 等下，我鞋带散了。

examples.en: Tom untied the ropes.
examples.zh: 汤姆解开了绳子。

examples.en: Your shoes are untied.
examples.zh: 您的鞋带散了。

unusually.definition: r. to a remarkable degree or extent
unusually.translation: adv. 不寻常地, 异乎寻常地, (非正式)非常

examples.en: The weather is unusually cold.
examples.zh: 天气非常寒冷。

unwilling.definition: a. not disposed or inclined toward\ns. in spite of contrary volition
unwilling.translation: a. 不愿意的, 勉强的\n[法] 不愿意的, 勉强的, 不服从的

examples.en: Tom seems to be unwilling to do that for us.
Tom seems to be unwilling to do that for Mary.
Tom seems to be unwilling to be a suicide bomber.

upside-down.definition: s being in such a position that top and bottom are reversed
upside-down.translation: a. 颠倒的, 乱七八糟的

examples.en: You're holding the book upside-down. This is upside-down and this is right-side up.
examples.zh: 你把书拿反了，这是反面，这才是正面。

upstairs.definition:
n. the part of a building above the ground floor
a. on or of upper floors of a building
r. on a floor above
r. with respect to the mind
upstairs.translation: a. 楼上的\nadv. 在楼上, 向楼上, 处于更高地位\nn. 楼层

examples.en: Do you mind helping me carry this box upstairs?
examples.zh: 你可以帮我把这个箱子搬上楼吗？

examples.en: It seems that the burglar broke in through an upstairs window.
examples.zh: 强盗似乎是在上层破窗而入的。

examples.en: My room is upstairs on the left.
examples.zh: 我的房间在楼上的左边。

upwards.definition: r spatially or metaphorically from a lower to a higher position\nr to a later time

examples.en: Onwards and upwards.
examples.zh: 不断前进，不断向上。

examples.en: Monsieur D'Espilly, in the year 1772, calculated the population of France at upwards of 22 millions; namely, 10,562,631 males, and 11,451,726 females; consequently the proportion of females to males was about 14 to 13.
examples.zh: 1772 年，埃斯皮利先生计算出法国人口超过 2,200 万人；其中男性 10,562,631 人，女性 11,451,726 人；因此，女性与男性的比例约为 14 比 13。

used.translation: a. 使用过的, 二手的, 习惯的

examples.en: As a boy, I used to swim in the pond.
examples.zh: 我还是个小男孩时常去池塘游泳。

examples.en: I don't do that as well as I used to.
examples.zh: 我做得不如以前好了。

examples.en: You remind me of a boy I used to know.
examples.zh: 你让我想起我过去认识的一个男孩。

utensil.definition: n. an implement for practical use (especially in a household)

examples.en: While the rest of us work hard, the robber barons eat with gilded utensils.
examples.zh: 当我们其他人辛苦工作时，强盗贵族却用镀金餐具吃饭。

utilization.definition: n. the state of having been made use of

examples.en: Credit utilization constitutes a significant portion of a credit score.
To improve profits, we need to increase the utilization of our factory.
They are thinking about the utilization of plastic bags in the country.
